dict.string: System Sentinel empties the Trash through Finder, opens a Terminal sudo shell for protected processes, and lists and closes Chrome tabs you choose.
System Sentinel measures folder sizes to show where disk space goes and to offer cleanups. Nothing leaves your Mac.
